name: Dirty Money
description: Unmarked, untraceable, and spent before anyone asks where it came from.

name: Mercenary Contracts
description: Standing agreements with outfits that shoot first and invoice later.

name: Blackmail Dossier
description: Photographs, ledgers, and one very compromising guest list.

name: Gold Bullion
description: Heavy, shiny, and utterly indifferent to sanctions.

name: State Secrets
description: Classified files worth more than the country that classified them.

name: Prototype Railgun
description: A weapon that officially does not exist, which makes it hard to report stolen.

name: Midnight Lens
description: A meter-wide focusing mirror of impossible precision — the heart of an orbital array.

name: Prototype Fusion Core
description: Enough clean energy to power a city — or one spectacular act of villainy.

name: Offshore Slush Fund
description: Grease for palms at every altitude.

name: The Inside Man
description: Someone on the payroll opens the right door at the right moment.

name: Holo-Disguise Kit
description: Be anyone. Badge checks, retina scans, and awkward reunions all pass.

name: EMP Scrambler
description: Cameras hiccup, logs corrupt, and the site never learns it was hit.

name: Ghost Protocol Kit
description: Burner identities and clean exits. The trail ends at a locker that never existed.

name: Decoy Doubles
description: Body doubles and staged sightings send every nemesis chasing shadows.

name: Auto-Doc Drone
description: Hovers over the op, stitches wounds mid-firefight, bills nobody.
